description: NormalizedIter implements RFC 4518 whitespace/case normalization as an iterator without allocating. The pending_space state machine is non-obvious but well-tested and necessary for no_std. A contributor may suggest replacing it with a simpler Vec-based implementation. Don't: the allocation is forbidden in no_std paths.
title: NormalizedIter: allocation-free RFC 4518 normalization is worth keeping
